method: AI reading of12frozen public stems,36existing answers and submitted snippets. Plausibility is weaker than direct entailment. No human/external expert review or blind/heldout claim; independent of Gold/scoredsummary/aliases, not model family.

questions.stem: What kind of viscosity is found in long-chain hydrocarbons?
questions.review: High viscosity is a plausible comparative description. Dense includes viscosity context; Hybrid drops it. Phase/temperature/comparator are omitted; no observed answer deterioration.

questions.stem: How does a neon light produce visible light?
questions.review: All3 describe electrical excitation and photon emission. Dense omits explicit return to lower energy but is coherent. Submitted neon passages directly support the mechanism.

questions.stem: What is the height above or below sea level called?
questions.review: Elevation is a plausible standard term. Passages discuss altitude/sea level but do not define elevation; insufficient support is not incorrect science.

questions.stem: What force makes objects seem lighter in water?
questions.review: Buoyancy and buoyant force express the same apparent-weight reduction mechanism. Retrieved passages concern surface tension; no direct support.

questions.stem: During telophase , the chromosomes begin to uncoil and form what?
questions.review: Chromatin correctly names the decondensed material, directly supported by the telophase paragraph. Applies to typical mitosis, not every meiotic telophase.

questions.stem: What term means the amount of water vapor in the air?
questions.review: Humidity is a plausible standard term. Hybrid has related humidification context but no exact definition; Dense water-vapor/pressure passages do not establish the term.

questions.stem: A frameshift mutation is a deletion or insertion of one or more of what that changes the reading frame of the base sequence?
questions.review: Nucleotides names the units correctly. Stem requires a reading-frame change. Some figure captions misleadingly call3-base insertion a frameshift; do not copy that premise.

questions.stem: The air pressure is about 80% that of ________ pressure at sea level.
questions.review: All3 inherit incomplete80%-pressure premise: no altitude/location. Atmospheric and normal sea-level baseline completions are plausible; normal is not proved scientifically wrong.

questions.stem: Only about one percent of plants have lost what ability, turning them into consumers and even predators, instead of producers?
questions.review: Photosynthesis is plausible intended ability. Snippets do not establish one-percent/lost-ability/predator claims. Carnivory does not necessarily imply loss of photosynthesis; premise needs review.

questions.stem: The protein without the prosthetic group is known as the what?
questions.review: Apoprotein is plausible AI-known terminology, not named in submitted chunks. Dense aprotein is nonstandard/misspelled, not a demonstrated alternate scientific proposition.

questions.stem: Collateral ganglia controls organs in which cavity in the body?
questions.review: Dense/Hybrid abdominal cavity is directly supported. E0 abdominopelvic cavity is broader plausible scope. Stem specifies no exhaustive-all-organs scope; no proven RAG scientific error.

questions.stem: During what part of a person's development are they generally at their physical peak?
questions.review: Young and early adulthood are plausible synonymous stages. Physical peak depends on measure/person; neither retrieval set directly establishes this claim.

evidence_support_legend.none: No direct submitted support; E0 has no evidence by design. Does not mean incorrect science.
evidence_support_legend.direct: Passage entails answer at stated scope.
evidence_support_legend.partial: Supports background/part, not complete term or claim.

rows: By passing an electrical current through neon gas at a low pressure, which excites the neon atoms and causes them to emit photons of light.
An electrical current passes through neon gas at low pressure, exciting the neon atoms and causing them to emit photons as they return to a lower energy state.

A neon light produces visible light when an electrical current passes through the neon gas inside the tube, causing the atoms to become excited and release photons as they return to a lower energy state.
uncertainty: No external verification. No aggregate semantic score or proven causal packing/checker conclusion from answer-only calls.
